}

}

Table "Research_Staff" {

}

Table "Staff_Roles" {
  "role_code" TEXT [pk]

}

Table "Tasks" {
  "task_id" INTEGER [pk]
  "project_id" INTEGER [not null]
  "task_details" TEXT [not null]
  "eg Agree Objectives" TEXT
}

Ref: "Documents"."grant_id" > "Grants"."grant_id"

Ref: "Documents"."document_type_code" > "Document_Types"."document_type_code"

Ref: "Grants"."organisation_id" > "Organisations"."organisation_id"

Ref: "Project_Outcomes"."outcome_code" > "Research_Outcomes"."outcome_code"

Ref: "Project_Outcomes"."project_id" > "Projects"."project_id"

Ref: "Project_Staff"."role_code" > "Staff_Roles"."role_code"

Ref: "Project_Staff"."project_id" > "Projects"."project_id"

Ref: "Projects"."organisation_id" > "Organisations"."organisation_id"

Ref: "Research_Staff"."employer_organisation_id" > "Organisations"."organisation_id"

Ref: "Tasks"."project_id" > "Projects"."project_id"
